notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 Released
notes.content:
We've made some further tweaks and balances to the new Warzone game mode as well as some general improvements to the game!

*** Windows 10 Xbox One controllers ***
There's now a special option in the gamepad settings that should fix issues for everyone who runs the latest driver for Xbox One controllers.

Patch notes:
General:
- Forced bounty selection when hosting a game from the matchmake dialog
- Increased size for one of the challenge rooms
- Removed auto aim on chain damage
- Reduced the total number of enemies in a room for 3 and 4 player balance
- Increased price and decreased duration for the Berserking powerup
- Reduced the health of all disruptive enemies
- Shielded Vanguard now cancels attack when hit
- Added effect when a player revive is completed

Warzone:
- Fixed a bug where the closing indicator for shops and terminals was sometimes not visible
- Clones of minibosses now get correct abilities
- Disruptive enemies and minibosses no longer spawn in the same rooms
- Reduced the possible amount of floors on block 2 and 3
- Reduced the possible amount of total rooms on all blocks by 5
- Some elite enemy types are restricted to blocks 2 and 3
- Balanced the enemy compositions
- Quitting to main menu now resets the Warzone block progress

Controller improvements:
- Added an option in the settings screen to select if one uses Windows 10 with an XBox One controller

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 Warzone is now live!
notes.content:
Our first free content update for the game is now live! 
Check out the details of all the new features in this thread: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/241760/discussions/0/368542844488514871/

Apart from the new content the following fixes and changes have been made:

Balance changes
Ivan Ironfist - Armorbreaker ability  debuff now causes enemy to take double damage on next incoming hit. Previously +1 damage
Bounty Target Fights - A higher amount of Bounty Target cohorts can now spawn before the population cap of the boss room is reached
Enemy Rocketlauncher - Enemy rockets now inflict 3 damage
Boss Abilities - Switched some boss abilities to different Bounty Targets in the Story
Perfect room clear - The perfect room clear tech bonus have been lowered from 20 to 10 for normal difficulty

Bug fixes
Fair Bounty Rewards - Bounty Rewards will now be adjusted in value according to the Difficulty level chosen
Spectate mode - Spectate target can now be changed with the mouse. Fixed some GUI issues when spectating
Boss Music - Fixed two instances where the wrong boss music was playing
Boss Abilities - The last Bounty Target (Story) now has the correct abilities
Damaged after killing target - Players no longer takes damage after watching the target clear animation when killing a bounty target
Powerups icon - HUD element no longer switches place after changing floors
Pushed off ledges - When hanging on ledges or being down but not out you should now be invulnerable
Necrocrator ledge - Necrocrators no longer target players hanging from a ledge
Akimbo Goon Shooting - Akimbo Goons will no longer abort their shooting if they target an Ivan-player that blinks
Penetrator enemy - Can now be affected by electricity stun

notes.title: Free Content Update 1: Warzone
notes.content:
http://piecesinteractive.se/wp/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/IMG_19042016_125606.png
We’re excited to bring you our first major content pack for Kill to Collect, and it’s free! In this new update, which will be available to all players on April 21st, we’ve added some improvements to current features and a whole arsenal of dangerous weapons and items for you to find!

Warzone Game Mode
The Warzone game mode revamps and improves on the current Free Hunt game mode. We felt that the Free Hunt mode could be a lot more interesting and the result is an evolved version we renamed Warzone. Prepare to enter levels where you get to face a mix of all the enemies in the game, in longer levels and where you never know when the next health station, ammo station or item vendor is going to appear!

Fight your way through 3 increasingly difficult blocks of Geoshelter Alpha where everything is a warzone. If you fail a block, you have to restart on Block 1, regardless of any progress you have made. Make it through all 3 blocks and receive tons of credits, a new achievement and a new skin for your character.

In addition to fighting all enemies the game offers, we are also introducing minibosses! Minibosses can spawn in random rooms to make each run more of a challenge! They might not have as many special abilities as the big bosses, but you’ll have to fight them in much smaller areas. There will also be special Elite enemies in each level that makes things difficult for you.

Welcome to the Warzone, Hunter!

New Weapons!
We are introducing several new weapons, items and powerups to the game. We hope you will experiment with these new combinations and see what strategies they offer to take down the trash of Geoshelter Alpha!

http://i1.wp.com/piecesinteractive.se/wp/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/minigun.png
Who doesn’t enjoy a great big hulking gun? Great range and fire-rate cuts through most enemies quickly but can you handle the pushback? They might be a rare to find or expensive to buy so if you get it, enjoy it!

http://i1.wp.com/piecesinteractive.se/wp/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/plasma_gun.png
A cheap and common Plasma Gun. Strange that you haven’t found it as they are common in all areas of Geoshelter Alpha. The Plasma Gun quickly fires three projectiles at enemies. Does high damage if all projectiles land. A cheap and dirty way to kill enemies quickly.

http://i0.wp.com/piecesinteractive.se/wp/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/rail_gun.png
Be sure to aim carefully to make the most out of this powerful weapon. The Railgun pierces all enemies in a line and does large damage to them. Let’s see some nice skillshots if you can find this rare gun.

http://i2.wp.com/piecesinteractive.se/wp/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/electric_grenade.png
Does minor damage to enemies and stuns them. Use it to gain control of a room and get out of messy situations.

http://i2.wp.com/piecesinteractive.se/wp/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/stungrenade.png
The Stun Grenade does not damage enemies but instead stuns them in a large area for a long duration. Any damage breaks the stun. Place some strategic Proximity Mines or focus down one pesky enemy while her friends are stunned to maximize the effect of the Stun Grenade.

New Items & Powerups!
http://i0.wp.com/piecesinteractive.se/wp/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/pushbacker.png
This item pushes back all enemies in an area around you. Useful to create some distance between you and your foes in challenge rooms or when you are trapped in a corner.

http://i1.wp.com/piecesinteractive.se/wp/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/kamipack.png
Get your own Kamibot! This item give you three Kamibots to wreak havoc among your enemies. Time to make your enemies feel that special Kamibot panic.

http://i2.wp.com/piecesinteractive.se/wp/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/cryo.png
This item slows down enemies in an area. Useful to control fast-moving enemies or take care of that miniboss.

http://i0.wp.com/piecesinteractive.se/wp/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/reflect.png
This powerup makes all players reflect any damage taken back to their enemies. Players still take damage but now it actually serves a purpose.

http://i1.wp.com/piecesinteractive.se/wp/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/berserking.png
This powerup makes all players move faster and do increased damage. But be careful! Players also takes more damage.

Balance Updates
We have also tweaked and fixed a lot of bugs and other minor issues. There will be changes to both enemies and hunters. More information and a detailed changelog of these tweaks will be released on thursday!


If any of these updates seems interesting you should definitely check out our  devstreams  this week! We’ll be giving you a quick look of the upgrade later this evening (April 19, 5pm UTC) and this Thursday (April 21, 5pm UTC) we’ll be playing the update alongside the community!

notes.title: Kill to Collect Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
This is a small hot-fix to improve matchmaking in Kill to Collect. We are working on further improvements to the system.

- Improved matchmaking range
- Changed lobbys to default to open

We are preparing larger content patches in the coming weeks. Follow us on twitter (@piecesint) for some teasers!
